fixtures.content: The worktree hooks of D70 (lot 14): every case builds its own scratch repository with mktemp and removes it.

cases.name: D70: the script creates .claude/worktrees/<name> from HEAD on <prefix>/<name> (repo.yaml contrib.branch), links every folder of layout.shared to the main checkout's - an absent one created empty there first -, writes the exclude block so the links stay untracked, prints the path alone on stdout and everything else on stderr (the warm-build line of B8 included), and reuses an existing worktree
cases.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-wt-{{SID}}-XXXXXX") || exit 1; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; G="git -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c user.name=eval -c init.defaultBranch=main"; $G init -q "$d/main" && cd "$d/main" && mkdir -p src .claude/harness/packs/repo-x/references packages/cache && printf 'x
' > src/a.txt && printf 'blob
' > packages/cache/p.nupkg && printf '**/[Pp]ackages/*
.claude/
node_modules/
' > .gitignore && printf 'product: X
layout:
  shared: [packages, node_modules]
contrib:
  branch: "feature|fix|chore/<slug>"
' > .claude/harness/packs/repo-x/references/repo.yaml && $G add -A && $G commit -qm init || { printf 'setup failed'; exit 1; }; out=$(bash {{CLAUDE}}/scripts/worktree-create.sh alpha 2>"$d/err"); rc=$?; wt="$d/main/.claude/worktrees/alpha"; r="rc=$rc"; [ "$out" = "$wt" ] && r="$r path=ok" || r="$r path=[$out]"; r="$r branch=$(git -C "$wt" branch --show-current)"; r="$r base=$([ "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ] && echo head || echo other)"; r="$r packages=$([ -L "$wt/packages" ] && [ "$(readlink -f "$wt/packages")" = "$d/main/packages" ] && echo linked || echo no)"; r="$r node_modules=$([ -d node_modules ] && [ -L "$wt/node_modules" ] && echo created+linked || echo no)"; r="$r exclude=$(grep -c '^/packages$\|^/node_modules$' .git/info/exclude)"; r="$r status=[$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)]"; r="$r stderr=$(grep -c 'worktree-create:' "$d/err")"; out2=$(bash {{CLAUDE}}/scripts/worktree-create.sh alpha 2>/dev/null); r="$r reuse=$([ "$out2" = "$wt" ] && echo ok || echo no)"; r="$r worktrees=$(git worktree list | wc -l)"; printf '%s' "$r"

expect.stdout: rc=0 path=ok branch=feature/alpha base=head packages=linked node_modules=created+linked exclude=2 status=[] stderr=4 reuse=ok worktrees=2

cases.name: D70: refused, nothing created - a shared folder git tracks (HARNESS_WORKTREE_SHARED=src), one that is not a relative folder of the checkout, a name that is not a slug, a .claude that is a symbolic link; without a pack and without the switch a plain worktree on worktree-<name>
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-wt-{{SID}}-XXXXXX") || exit 1; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; G="git -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c user.name=eval -c init.defaultBranch=main"; $G init -q "$d/main" && cd "$d/main" && mkdir -p src && printf 'x\n' > src/a.txt && printf '.claude/\n' > .gitignore && $G add -A && $G commit -qm init || { printf 'setup failed'; exit 1; }; S={{CLAUDE}}/scripts/worktree-create.sh; r=""; o=$(HARNESS_WORKTREE_SHARED=src bash $S beta 2>"$d/e1"); r="$r[tracked:$?:${#o}:$(grep -c 'holds files git tracks' "$d/e1")]"; o=$(HARNESS_WORKTREE_SHARED=../out bash $S beta 2>"$d/e2"); r="$r[outside:$?:${#o}:$(grep -c 'not a relative folder' "$d/e2")]"; o=$(bash $S 'a/b' 2>/dev/null); r="$r[slug:$?:${#o}]"; mkdir -p "$d/elsewhere" && ln -s "$d/elsewhere" .claude && o=$(bash $S gamma 2>"$d/e3"); r="$r[symlink:$?:${#o}:$(grep -c 'symbolic link' "$d/e3")]"; rm .claude; r="$r[worktrees:$(git worktree list | wc -l)]"; o=$(bash $S delta 2>"$d/e4"); r="$r[plain:$?:$(git -C "$o" branch --show-current):$(grep -c 'linked' "$d/e4")]"; printf '%s' "$r"

cases.name: D70: --link equips a worktree made by hand - an empty folder gives way to the link, a non-empty one is refused -, --shared lists the folders resolved, and the start line reads the links
cases.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-wt-{{SID}}-XXXXXX") || exit 1; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; G="git -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c user.name=eval -c init.defaultBranch=main"; $G init -q "$d/main" && cd "$d/main" && mkdir -p src .claude/harness/packs/repo-x/references packages && printf 'x
' > src/a.txt && printf '**/[Pp]ackages/*
.claude/
' > .gitignore && printf 'layout:
  shared:
    - packages
' > .claude/harness/packs/repo-x/references/repo.yaml && $G add -A && $G commit -qm init && $G worktree add -q "$d/hand" -b hand 2>/dev/null || { printf 'setup failed'; exit 1; }; S={{CLAUDE}}/scripts/worktree-create.sh; r=""; mkdir "$d/hand/packages"; o=$(HARNESS_WORKTREE_SHARED=cache bash $S --link "$d/hand" 2>"$d/e1"); r="$r[link:$?:${#o}:$([ -L "$d/hand/packages" ] && echo L || echo -):$([ -L "$d/hand/cache" ] && [ -d cache ] && echo L || echo -)]"; r="$r[shared:$(HARNESS_WORKTREE_SHARED=cache bash $S --shared "$d/hand" 2>/dev/null | tr '
' ',')]"; $G worktree add -q "$d/full" -b full 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p "$d/full/packages" && printf 'y
' > "$d/full/packages/f"; o=$(bash $S --link "$d/full" 2>"$d/e2"); r="$r[full:$?:$(grep -c 'not empty' "$d/e2"):$([ -d "$d/full/packages" ] && [ ! -L "$d/full/packages" ] && echo kept || echo gone)]"; o=$(bash $S --link "$d/main" 2>/dev/null); r="$r[main:$?]"; printf '%s' "$r"

cases.name: D70: --remove refuses a worktree with an untracked file, then one with a commit no other branch holds, the folder kept each time; once merged (or pushed) it removes the worktree, its links and its branch, the main checkout's folders intact; a locked worktree is refused; the main checkout is refused
cases.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-wt-{{SID}}-XXXXXX") || exit 1; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; G="git -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c user.name=eval -c init.defaultBranch=main"; $G init -q "$d/main" && cd "$d/main" && mkdir -p src .claude/harness/packs/repo-x/references packages && printf 'x
' > src/a.txt && printf 'p
' > packages/p && printf '**/[Pp]ackages/*
.claude/
' > .gitignore && printf 'layout:
  shared: [packages]
' > .claude/harness/packs/repo-x/references/repo.yaml && $G add -A && $G commit -qm init || { printf 'setup failed'; exit 1; }; S={{CLAUDE}}/scripts/worktree-create.sh; wt=$(bash $S alpha 2>/dev/null) || { printf 'create failed'; exit 1; }; r=""; printf 'n
' > "$wt/src/n.txt"; bash $S --remove "$wt" 2>"$d/e1"; r="$r[untracked:$?:$(grep -c 'changed or untracked' "$d/e1"):$([ -d "$wt" ] && echo kept || echo gone)]"; $G -C "$wt" add -A && $G -C "$wt" commit -qm wip; r="$r[committed-links-ignored:$(git -C "$wt" ls-files | grep -c '^packages$')]"; bash $S --remove "$wt" 2>"$d/e2"; r="$r[unmerged:$?:$(grep -c 'no other branch has' "$d/e2"):$([ -d "$wt" ] && echo kept || echo gone)]"; git worktree lock "$wt"; bash $S --remove "$wt" 2>"$d/e3"; r="$r[locked:$?:$(grep -c 'locked' "$d/e3")]"; git worktree unlock "$wt"; $G merge -q worktree-alpha; bash $S --remove "$wt" 2>"$d/e4"; r="$r[merged:$?:$([ -e "$wt" ] && echo kept || echo gone):$(git branch --list worktree-alpha | wc -l):$(cat packages/p)]"; bash $S --remove "$d/main" 2>/dev/null; r="$r[main:$?]"; bash $S --remove "$d/nowhere" 2>/dev/null; r="$r[absent:$?]"; printf '%s' "$r"

cases.name: D70: the WorktreeCreate hook runs the script from the payload's cwd and prints the path as its last stdout line; the WorktreeRemove hook removes with the script's refusals; both exit 0 silently on empty, {}, not JSON and another event
cases.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-wt-{{SID}}-XXXXXX") || exit 1; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; G="git -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c user.name=eval -c init.defaultBranch=main"; $G init -q "$d/main" && cd "$d/main" && mkdir -p src packages && printf 'x
' > src/a.txt && printf '**/[Pp]ackages/*
.claude/
' > .gitignore && $G add -A && $G commit -qm init || { printf 'setup failed'; exit 1; }; HC={{CLAUDE}}/hooks/worktree-create.sh; HR={{CLAUDE}}/hooks/worktree-remove.sh; r=""; o=$(cd / && printf '{"hook_event_name":"WorktreeCreate","session_id":"{{SID}}","cwd":"%s","name":"agent-ab12"}' "$d/main" | HARNESS_WORKTREE_SHARED=packages bash $HC 2>"$d/e1"); r="$r[create:$?:$([ "$(printf '%s
' "$o" | grep -v '^$' | tail -n 1)" = "$d/main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ab12" ] && echo path || echo "[$o]"):$(git -C "$d/main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ab12" branch --show-current):$([ -L "$d/main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ab12/packages" ] && echo linked || echo -)]"; printf 'w
' > "$d/main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ab12/src/w.txt"; o=$(printf '{"hook_event_name":"WorktreeRemove","session_id":"{{SID}}","worktree_path":"%s"}' "$d/main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ab12" | bash $HR 2>/dev/null); r="$r[remove-dirty:$?:${#o}:$([ -d "$d/main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ab12" ] && echo kept || echo gone)]"; rm "$d/main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ab12/src/w.txt"; o=$(printf '{"hook_event_name":"WorktreeRemove","session_id":"{{SID}}","worktree_path":"%s"}' "$d/main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ab12" | bash $HR 2>/dev/null); r="$r[remove-clean:$?:${#o}:$([ -e "$d/main/.claude/worktrees/agent-ab12" ] && echo kept || echo gone):$(git branch --list worktree-agent-ab12 | wc -l)]"; for p in '' '{}' 'nope' '{"hook_event_name":"SessionStart"}'; do for h in $HC $HR; do o=$(printf '%s' "$p" | bash $h 2>&1); r="$r$?${#o}"; done; done; printf '%s' "$r"

cases.name: plan B8 (2026-10-12): a fresh worktree starts `commands.restore && commands.build` of repo.yaml in the background, detached - the script returns before the restore ends -, its output in <main>/.claude/local/worktrees/<name>.build.txt with a `command:` first line and `exit=<n>` last; no commands.restore in the pack: the file says skipped and exit=0, nothing runs; a reused worktree starts nothing; --remove deletes the file
cases.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-wt-{{SID}}-XXXXXX") || exit 1; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; G="git -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c user.name=eval -c init.defaultBranch=main"; $G init -q "$d/main" && cd "$d/main" && mkdir -p src .claude/harness/packs/repo-x/references packages && printf 'x
' > src/a.txt && printf '**/[Pp]ackages/*
.claude/
' > .gitignore && printf 'product: X
layout:
  shared: [packages]
commands:
  restore: sleep 4; printf r
  build: printf b
  test: dotnet test X.sln --no-build
' > .claude/harness/packs/repo-x/references/repo.yaml && $G add -A && $G commit -qm init || { printf 'setup failed'; exit 1; }; S={{CLAUDE}}/scripts/worktree-create.sh; t0=$(date +%s); wt=$(bash $S alpha 2>"$d/err"); t1=$(date +%s); f="$d/main/.claude/local/worktrees/alpha.build.txt"; r="[fast:$([ $((t1-t0)) -lt 3 ] && echo yes || echo no:$((t1-t0)))][said:$(grep -c 'started in the background' "$d/err")][first:$(head -n 1 "$f" 2>/dev/null)]"; r="$r[pending:$(grep -c '^exit=' "$f")]"; for i in $(seq 1 40); do grep -q '^exit=' "$f" && break; sleep 0.25; done; r="$r[last:$(tail -n 1 "$f")][out:$(grep -c '^rb$' "$f")]"; : > "$f"; bash $S alpha >/dev/null 2>&1; r="$r[reuse:$(wc -c < "$f" | tr -d ' ')]"; $G init -q "$d/nocmd" && cd "$d/nocmd" && printf 'y
' > a && $G add -A && $G commit -qm i; wt2=$(bash $S beta 2>/dev/null); f2="$d/nocmd/.claude/local/worktrees/beta.build.txt"; r="$r[skipped:$(head -c 8 "$f2")/$(tail -n 1 "$f2")]"; bash $S --remove "$wt2" >/dev/null 2>&1; r="$r[removed:$([ -e "$f2" ] && echo kept || echo gone)]"; printf '%s' "$r"

cases.name: D70: the two hooks are wired in settings.json under WorktreeCreate and WorktreeRemove, the script ships in core (claude/scripts/), and the switches HARNESS_DEV_BATCHES_MAX (4), HARNESS_WORKTREE_SHARED and HARNESS_PR_AUTO (0, D71) have their defaults in the managed env
cases.cmd: S={{CLAUDE}}/settings.json; r=""; r="$r[create:$(jq -r '.hooks.WorktreeCreate[0].hooks[0].command' $S | grep -c 'hooks/worktree-create.sh')]"; r="$r[remove:$(jq -r '.hooks.WorktreeRemove[0].hooks[0].command' $S | grep -c 'hooks/worktree-remove.sh')]"; r="$r[script:$([ -x {{CLAUDE}}/scripts/worktree-create.sh ] && echo x || echo -)]"; r="$r[max:$(jq -r '.env.HARNESS_DEV_BATCHES_MAX' $S)][shared:$(jq -r '.env.HARNESS_WORKTREE_SHARED' $S)][pr:$(jq -r '.env.HARNESS_PR_AUTO' $S)]"; P={{CLAUDE}}/../profiles/packs/core.yaml; [ -f "$P" ] && r="$r[core:$(grep -c 'claude/scripts/\*\*' "$P")]" || r="$r[core:skipped]"; printf '%s' "$r"
